rules.logic: Fires when abioc `Microsoft SharePoint enumeration activity` and abioc `Microsoft OneDrive enumeration activity` both observe the same UserId and ClientIP within a 30-minute window, stitching the SharePoint page/search sweep and the OneDrive file sweep into one Discovery-stage cloud-repository enumeration incident rather than two independent alerts.
rules.name: SharePoint + OneDrive cloud-repository enumeration discovery stitch
